settings.content: Canonical values live in theme/brand/tokens.json. These settings emit CSS custom properties so sections do not need rewrites when a client bible is swapped. Page colors and fonts stay in Colors, Typography, and Page layout.
Emitted as CSS variables for scripts and new CSS. Existing Horizon @media queries stay literal so layout does not shift.

First-visit splash overlay. Hidden on cart and checkout. Uses Brand tokens for color, type, and motion. Enable in the theme editor; schema default is off so live stores do not change until you opt in.

settings.label: Duration
settings.info: 0 keeps the overlay until Skip or Escape.

settings.label: Use header logo
settings.info: Uses Theme settings → Logo. Falls back to the store name.

settings.label: Wordmark
settings.info: Shown when the logo is off, and as the accessible name when the logo is on. Defaults to the store name.
